passage:
Dear Tenzin,
I’ve been meaning to write since Sunday’s listening party. When I moved into the hostel in a new city, I ate dinner alone for a month. Then I found our fan group online and you, Mira and Joel wrote to me.
Someone drew my favourite character. Someone else shared a playlist when I had a bad week. On Sundays we listen together and talk about anything. When a group from another band mocked us, you said, “Let them be. We’re here for the songs.”
It’s the first place here that felt like mine. Thank you for that. ❤️
Sabina

qa.q: How long did Sabina eat dinner alone after moving to the hostel?
qa.a: Sabina ate dinner alone for a month after moving into the hostel.

qa.q: What was Sabina feeling before finding the fan group?
qa.a: Sabina was lonely in a new city, which is why the group felt like the first place that was Sabina's own.

qa.q: What did Tenzin's reply to the mocking group show about how the fan group works?
qa.a: Tenzin answered the mockery calmly and said they were there for the songs. It shows connection here does not depend on hating anyone.

qa.q: What might Joel or Mira have felt on hearing Sabina's message?
qa.a: They may have felt glad and a little proud that the group made a lonely person feel welcome. The letter thanks Tenzin mainly, so their feelings are a guess.

grounding: Shows a young adult finding connection and comfort in a fan community during a lonely time, without hatred of others.

passage:
Salma, you asked how the forum started. I’m Binita, and it was my first year at a university abroad, and I didn’t know anyone. My roommate was away most weekends, and evenings felt very long.
I started reading a forum for a detective series I loved. Then I posted a short story about one of the characters, and three strangers replied within an hour. One of them, Ines, started editing my spelling with jokes. After that we wrote stories together.
Once somebody posted hateful things about another series’ viewers, and the moderators deleted it and wrote, “We don’t do that here.” I stayed. I’m still there, and I’m still writing.

qa.q: What did Binita post that got replies from strangers?
qa.a: Binita posted a short story about one of the characters in the detective series.

qa.q: What was Binita feeling in the first weeks abroad?
qa.a: Binita felt lonely, since nobody was familiar and the evenings felt very long.

qa.q: What did the moderators' response to the hateful post show that helped Binita stay?
qa.a: They deleted it and said such posts were not allowed. That made the forum feel safe and showed connection did not depend on hating others.

qa.q: How might Ines have felt when the story-writing with Binita began?
qa.a: Ines probably felt welcomed and playful, since Ines replied so quickly and joked while helping with spelling. It suggests Ines also enjoyed finding someone to write with.

grounding: Shows a young adult finding connection and creative outlets in a fan forum during lonely first-year months.
